risks.risk: Tyre size (width/aspect/rim) and fitment are unknown, which affects the correct market price and whether it matches the buyer’s car.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size marking (e.g., 205/55R16) and brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown-size used tyre (worst-case for buyer matching), not premium by size.

risks.risk: Manufacture date (DOT) and true age are unknown; '2023 car' may not match tyre production date.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used stock (not guaranteed 2023), worst-case age.

risks.risk: Whether there is any hidden damage (sidewall cuts, internal damage) or prior repair is not fully visible.
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls (left/right) and the full circumference, plus a close-up of any suspicious spots; ideally a video spin showing bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially repaired/with unknown condition (worst-case: treat as not confirmed 'no patch/no bulge').

risks.risk: Tread depth cannot be confirmed as '90%'; tyres may be near the wear bars or unevenly worn.
risks.proof: Photo of tread wear indicators and/or a tread depth gauge reading (mm) at multiple points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not meeting 90% claim (worst-case: treat as average used tread).

proof_requests: Send a clear sidewall close-up showing: brand, tyre model (if any), full size (e.g., 205/55R16), and DOT date.
Send photos of both sidewalls (full circumference) to confirm no patch, no bulge, and no cuts.
Send tread depth measurement in mm at 3–4 points (or a photo of wear indicators).
Confirm quantity (how many tyres) and whether they are all the same size/model.
response.reason: From photo 0, tread looks decent, but the tyre’s exact size/brand/DOT and the key safety claims (no patch/bulge, true age) are not verifiable remotely. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
